forum.best_answer_content:
When it’s not on the Product Page, that means you have to request it direct from ST - possibly under NDA.

Find your local sales office here: <https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/contact-us.html>

Or raise a support case here: <https://ols.st.com/s/>

**PS:**

See also:

<https://community.st.com/others-hardware-and-software-57/i-bought-recently-the-steval-lll001v1-which-uses-the-led-driver-stled524-the-user-manual-um2143-which-describes-how-to-use-the-board-mention-the-program-stled524-v1-44-exe-or-higher-where-can-i-found-this-software-57020>
forum.content_text:
I recently purchased the STEVAL-LLL001V1 evaluation board, which uses the STLED524 LED driver. According to the user manual (UM2143), the board requires the software **STLED524\_V1.44.exe** (or a later version) for operation. However, I have been unable to locate this software.

Could you please let me know where I can download it?
forum.author: parul sharma
